description: This Dart file defines a singleton class 'NotesDb' that manages SQLite database interactions for a notes application. It includes schema setup, CRUD operations, and query methods for notes stored in a local database.

classes.name: NotesDb
classes.description: A singleton class providing low-level SQLite access with schema management and CRUD functionality for notes.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that initializes and returns the database instance.

methods.name: _openDb
methods.description: Internal method to open the database and create the schema if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by its ID.
